findings: Transformer loses several perimeter wires and preserves its two main columns, but still has excess source wrappers, long cross-scope routes and a different reading direction from the dedicated reference.

BraidedInputs retains one context terminal near its actual uses, reducing the long top-boundary fan-out. Its expanded source paths remain available; deeper docking is rejected when labels cannot be placed.
Both accepted layouts grow in width. No claim of complete semantic/reference correspondence, responsive UI rendering or thousands-node routed performance.
